blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning.
Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%.
A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies.
Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.
blocks.zh:
可靠的视觉推理需要编集多种视觉观测,并返回逻辑等效问题的一致答案. 我们介绍Hob-VL,这是视觉上基于布尔推理的基准。
Hob-VL包括两项任务:(1) 评估布尔规则是否在图像中存在;(2) 确定满足布尔描述的(独特的)对象。 Hob-VL包含6000个经人验证的均衡的Yes/No问题,每个问题由10个视觉语句的布尔组合来定义,跨越了1000个生成的场景和46个不同的标注照片,以及1000个标注在相同照片上的物体识别问题. 我们的提问家庭被刻意构建,通过误导本地提示和嵌套逻辑操作挑战推理,并包括象征性和结构化的自然语言演示. 在8个智障或最小化的模型配置中,布尔精度在48.52%至50.57%之间,而识别精度最高达到43.0%。
思维驱动的GLM配置在保留重大错误和不一致的同时,实现了不均衡的收益.
Hob-VL通过可执行的参考答案和匹配的评价来揭露这些失败.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding how vision-language models (VLMs) interpret and reason about images is a longstanding research goal ( Antol et al., 2015 ; Johnson et al., 2017 ; Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) . Many visual questions require identifying relevant objects, attributes, and relations, then combining these observations according to the question’s meaning. Yet answering individual visual questions correctly does not ensure correct answers to their logical combinations ( Gokhale et al., 2020 ) , and answers may change across meaning-preserving rephrasings ( Shah et al., 2019 ) . Reliable visual reasoning therefore requires both accurate composition and consistency across equivalent formulations.
blocks.zh: 了解视觉语言模型(VLMs)如何诠释和解释图像是一个长期的研究目标(Antol等人,2015年;Johnson等人,2017年;Hudson and Manning,2019年). 许多视觉问题需要识别相关的对象,属性和关系,然后根据问题的意义将这些观察结果综合起来. 然而,正确回答个人视觉问题并不能确保正确回答其逻辑组合(Gokhale等人,2020年),而且答案可能会在保留含义的重写中发生变化(Shah等人,2019年)。 因此,可靠的视觉推理要求精确的构成和等同的表述的一致性。

blocks.en: These capabilities matter when visual observations are combined with structured information to answer queries or guide decisions. For instance, EHRXQA links patient records to chest X-ray images ( Bae et al., 2023 ) , EQUI-VOCAL synthesizes queries for video events involving object attributes and relations ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and DriveLM connects perception, prediction, and planning through visual question answering ( Sima et al., 2024 ) . In an industrial application, a warehouse query might ask for a package that is damaged, is beside a loading bay, is not covered, and is not inside a container ( Subramanian et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) . Another illustrative application is to locate plants that are not under automated irrigation and either (i) have yellow leaves and are wilting or (ii) show pest damage. ( Zhang and Wang, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Soler et al., 2024 ) . Answering these queries correctly requires evaluating the specified combination of conditions for the same object.
blocks.zh: 当视觉观测与结构化信息相结合以回答询问或指导决定时,这些能力就很重要. 例如,EHRXQA将患者记录与胸部X射线图像联系起来(Bae等人,2023年),EQUI-VOCAL综合了涉及物体属性和关系的视频事件的询问(Zhang等人,2023年),DriveLM通过视觉问题回答将感知,预测和规划联系起来(Sima等人,2024年). 在工业申请中,仓储查询可能要求有一个包件损坏,在装货海湾旁,没有覆盖,也没有在集装箱内(Subramanian等人,2023年;Liu等人,2022年)。 另一种说明性应用是找到没有自动灌溉的植物,这些植物有(一)有黄叶,正在枯萎或(二)有虫害损害。 (张和王,2024;王等人,2022;索勒等人,2024). 正确回答这些询问需要评价同一对象的具体条件组合.

blocks.en:
Diagnostic benchmarks have made these capabilities amenable to systematic study. For instance, VQA v2 pairs similar images requiring different answers to the same question to counter language priors ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , CLEVR uses controlled scenes and executable question programs ( Johnson et al., 2017 ) , and GQA combines structured question generation with consistency evaluation on photographs ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) . CLOSURE further shows that strong CLEVR performance need not transfer to new combinations of familiar referring expressions ( Bahdanau et al., 2019 ) . We build on these diagnostics to ask whether VLMs can evaluate
explicit Boolean combinations of visual facts and preserve their
answers when the same function is expressed differently.

blocks.en: Boolean logic provides a natural and precise setting in which to investigate these ideas ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Under this lens, in the formal logic terminology, the literals (Boolean variables), stem from directly observable visual statements, while conjunction ( ∧ \land , the Boolean ‘AND’), disjunction ( ∨ \lor , the Boolean ‘OR’), and negation ( ¬ \neg , the Boolean ‘NOT’) determine how those values combine to form an answer. Together, this set of operators can express any Boolean function over a finite set of binary facts ( O’Donnell, 2014 ) , providing a rich language for composing such conditions. One immediate advantage here is that their explicit semantics allow reference answers to be computed from annotated observations and equivalences between expressions to be checked exactly.
blocks.zh: Boolean逻辑提供了一个自然而精确的设定,调查这些想法(Lee等人,2026年). 在这个镜头下,在形式逻辑术语中,字面(Boolean variables)来自直接可观察到的视觉语句,同时结合(\\\ land,布尔`AND ' ),分离(\\ lor,布尔`OR ' ),否定(\\ neg,布尔`NOT ' )决定这些值如何结合,形成答案。 这组操作员可以用一组有限的二进制事实来表达任何布尔函数(O'Donnell, 2014), 这里的一个直接好处是,它们的明确语义允许从附加注释的观测结果中计算出参考答案,并准确检查各种表达词之间的等同性。

blocks.en: Within this setting, the demands of composition can be characterized more precisely than by question length alone. For instance, one false input condition might settle a long conjunction, whereas other functions might require several input values to be known. Boolean-function analysis quantifies input influence (how often changing an input changes the answer) and certificate size (the minimum number of fact values sufficient to determine the answer for a given instance) as well as predictability from limited evidence ( O’Donnell, 2014 ) . Nested expressions additionally organize computation into intermediate subproblems, motivating tests of successive composition, and a strong benchmark should record properties of the expression tree, such as depth and connective alternation. Theoretical studies of transformer expressivity establish that intermediate generation can extend computational capabilities under specific architectural assumptions ( Merrill and Sabharwal, 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Anand et al., 2026a ; Anand et al., 2026b ) , motivating our comparison of inference configurations.
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下,对组成要求的描述可以比仅是提问时间更精确。 例如,一个虚假的输入条件可能解决长时间的结合,而其他函数则可能需要知道几个输入值。 布尔函数分析将输入影响(如何经常改变输入会改变答案)和证书大小(足够确定特定实例答案的最小事实值)以及有限证据的可预测性(O ' Donnell, 2014)量化。 嵌入式表达式另外组织计算成中间子问题,激发连续构成的测试,强基准应记录表达式树的属性,如深度和连接性交替. 对变压器表达性进行理论研究,确定在具体建筑假设下,中间一代可以延长计算能力(Merrill和Sabharwal,2024年;Li等人,2024年;Anand等人,2026a年); Anand et al., 2026b ),激励我们比较推论配置.

blocks.en: We introduce Hob-VL , a benchmark that combines exact Boolean-function annotations with paired evaluations of visually grounded reasoning: equivalent expressions within a presentation format, and symbolic versus structured natural-language presentations of the same question. The benchmark contains 6,000 6{,}000 balanced Yes/No questions over 1,000 1{,}000 generated scenes and 46 46 labeled photographs, together with 1,000 1{,}000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. The Yes/No questions combine ten visual statements and form 3,000 human-verified original/De Morgan-rewrite pairs, while the identification questions combine two to five spatial predicates. We make each question available in both presentation formats, enabling separate comparisons of equivalent expressions and symbolic versus natural-language presentation. We illustrate these tasks in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Hob-VL, 将精确的布尔函数说明与对视觉推理的配对评价结合起来的基准:在演示格式中等同表达, 基准包含6000 6{,}000 均衡是/否的问题超过1,000 1{,}000 生成的场景和46 张标有标签的照片,以及1000 1{,}000 物体识别问题放在同一个照片上. "是/否"问题结合了10个视觉语句,形成3000个经人验证的原创/德摩根重写对子,而识别问题则结合了2-5个空间上游. 我们以两种列报方式提供每个问题,从而能够对等式表述和象征性表述与自然语言表述进行单独比较。 我们在图1中说明了这些任务。

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers eight VLMs in nine configurations, collecting 126K responses. Across the eight configurations with disabled/minimized thinking, Boolean accuracy remains near 50% (surprisingly, the same accuracy a coin flip between the answers!), while object-identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0 % 43.0\% under the recorded scoring policies. The thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves substantially higher accuracy on symbolic Boolean evaluation and both identification formats, but improves little on natural-language Boolean evaluation and still frequently gives conflicting answers to equivalent expressions. These findings highlight persistent difficulties in visually grounded composition and demonstrate the importance of reporting evaluation metrics such as item accuracy, pairwise correctness, disagreement, and output validity together.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涵盖八个VLM的9个配置,收集了126K的回复. 在8个思维障碍/最小化的配置中,布尔精度仍然接近50%(令人惊讶的是,答案之间硬币翻转的精度相同!),而在记录的评分政策下,对象识别精度高达43.0%。 思维驱动的GLM配置在符号布尔评价以及两种识别格式上都实现了显著更高的精度,但在自然语言布尔评价上却鲜有改进,仍然经常对等式表达给出相互矛盾的答案. 这些调查结果突出表明了在视网膜构成方面持续存在的困难,并表明报告项目准确性、双向正确性、分歧和产出有效性等评价指标的重要性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Compositional visual reasoning. VQA established large-scale evaluation of answers to natural-language questions about images ( Antol et al., 2015 ) , and VQA v2 introduced complementary images to reduce exploitable language priors ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) . CLEVR combines generated scenes with executable question programs and measures effective question size through answer-preserving program pruning ( Johnson et al., 2017 ) . GQA generates compositional questions from scene graphs of photographs and evaluates consistency using entailment relations ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) . CLOSURE tests CLEVR-trained models on unfamiliar combinations of known referring expressions ( Bahdanau et al., 2019 ) .
Hob-VL adds exhaustive truth-table annotations for ten-input Boolean
functions and pairs each base Yes/No expression with an equivalent
rewrite, and its evaluation measures correctness and consistency on the
released items.
blocks.zh:
组成视觉推理. VQA建立了对图像自然语言问题答案的大规模评价(Antol等人,2015年),VQA v2引入了互补图像以减少可开发语言前传(Goyal等人,2017年). CLEVR将生成的场景与可执行的提问程序相结合,并通过解答保留程序普鲁恩(Johnson等人,2017年)衡量有效的提问大小. GQA从照片的场景图中生成组成问题,并使用涵义关系评价一致性(Hudson and Manning, 2019). CLOSURE测试CLEVR训练的模型,测试已知参考表达词的不熟悉组合(Bahdanau等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Multimodal logical reasoning. VQA-LOL directly studies Boolean combinations of visual questions, including conjunction, disjunction, and negation ( Gokhale et al., 2020 ) . LogicVista and VisuLogic evaluate diverse forms of reasoning in visual contexts ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . MuSLR more specifically tests multimodal inference grounded in propositional, first-order, and non-monotonic rules ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , while MM-CondChain constructs visually grounded conditional chains using a programmatically verifiable intermediate representation ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . Hob-VL focuses on evaluating supplied Boolean functions and selecting objects that satisfy Boolean descriptions. Its Yes/No task supports exhaustive function analysis and verified expression rewrites, and both tasks support matched symbolic and structured natural-language presentations.
blocks.zh: 多式联运逻辑推理. VQA-LOL直接研究布尔组合的视觉问题,包括连结,脱钩和否定(Gokhale等人,2020年). LogicVista和VisuLogic评价了视觉背景下的各种推理形式(Xiao等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年b). MuSLR更具体地测试基于命题规则、第一顺序规则和非模拟规则的多式联运推论(徐等人,2025年a),而MM-CondChain则利用可进行方案核查的中间代表构建了视基条件链(沈等人,2026年)。 Hob-VL专注于评价所提供的布尔函数,并选择满足布尔描述的对象. 其 " 是/否 " 任务支持详尽的函数分析和经核实的表达式重写,这两个任务支持都符合象征性和结构化的自然语言演示文稿。

blocks.en: Equivalent formulations and logical sensitivity. VQA-Rephrasings and Global PIQA test robustness to human-written visual-question rephrasings ( Shah et al., 2019 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) . In text, RobustLR evaluates minimal logical edits and equivalence conditions ( Sanyal et al., 2022 ) , while CRTBench includes both equivalence-preserving and answer-reversing reformulations ( Gu and Chen, 2026 ) . FACTOR-Bench evaluates logical constraints through dual-encoder scoring and includes an equivalence split with De Morgan transformations, double negation, and commutativity ( Alshehri et al., 2026 ) . Logic Unseen introduces a separate visual LogicBench for logic-aware retrieval and caption selection under logical perturbations ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Hob-VL compares generated answers across verified equivalent expressions and, separately, across symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. For equivalent expression pairs, it reports any disagreement among pairs with two valid outputs and the proportion of all pairs answered correctly on both members.
blocks.zh: 等效配体和逻辑敏感性. VQA-Rephrasings和Global PIQA测试强力到人文视觉问题重写(Shah等人,2019年;Chang等人,2026年). 在文字中,RobustLR评价最小的逻辑编辑和等效条件(Sanyal等人,2022年),而CRT Bench既包括等效保留,也包括回答反转重排(Gu和Chen,2026年). Textual logic and Boolean evaluation. ProofWriter generates implications and proofs from natural-language rules and facts ( Tafjord et al., 2021 ) , FOLIO pairs natural-language inference with first-order logical annotations ( Han et al., 2024 ) , and the textual LogicBench organizes examples around individual inference rules ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) . The Boolean Expressions task in BIG-Bench Hard evaluates expressions containing explicit True/False constants ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ) . Hob-VL obtains the inputs from visual evidence and characterizes the resulting functions using Boolean-function analysis ( O’Donnell, 2014 ) . SATBench asks whether constraints expressed as natural-language puzzles admit a satisfying assignment ( Wei et al., 2025 ) .
In Hob-VL’s Yes/No task, the image determines assignments, and the model evaluates the supplied expression at that assignment. Once the literals are known, the evaluation runtime is linear in the expression’s tree size.

blocks.en:
Grounding and interpretation. Reasoning performance in language models can vary with premise order ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and added input length ( Levy et al., 2024 ) , even when the required inference is unchanged. Nagar et al. (2024) compare visual embeddings with textual scene descriptions as inputs to underlying language models, illustrating the value of such controls for investigating visual reasoning. These findings motivate distinguishing a question’s recorded logical
properties from the processes responsible for model errors. Our paired evaluations measure end-to-end accuracy and consistency across equivalent expressions and symbolic and natural-language presentations.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: We construct Yes/No questions in four stages: annotate visual statements, sample Boolean expressions, compute solutions and diagnostics, and generate equivalent expressions. The annotations determine the truth values of the ten visual statements, and a Boolean interpreter evaluates each expression under resulting assignment. In turn, object-identification questions use the same photographs but a separate procedure that evaluates the description for every candidate object. We describe these procedures and their validation below.

blocks.en: Prompt generation. Each expression is rendered symbolically and with a fixed recursive natural-language grammar. AND requires both child conditions; OR requires at least one, including the case in which both hold; and NOT negates its entire child condition. In the natural-language rendering, each occurrence of a variable is replaced by its full visual statement. The natural-language prompts therefore preserve the supplied tree and explicitly mark logical scope, and are deterministic renderings. We specify the grammatical detail in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Object-identification construction. Nine templates combine two to five spatial predicates, evaluated using the annotated object reference points. For distinct objects, a horizontal comparison is unknown when their reference points differ by at most 6% of image width, and the corresponding threshold for a vertical comparison is 6% of image height. As previously mentioned, all self-relations are false. Therefore, we retain an item only if all predicates for its target have known values and the target is the unique satisfying candidate under every completion of the unknown values. Thus the target must satisfy the description, and every other candidate must fail it, regardless of how unknown comparisons are resolved. We require at least two known predicate values to distinguish the target from the other candidates. Separately, we fix self-relations to false and treat all relations between distinct objects as unknown, retaining a question only if at least two candidates can still satisfy the description. Finally, within each image, we duplicate descriptions that are Boolean-equivalent over the same named predicates.
blocks.zh: 对象识别构造. 9个模板结合了2至5个空间上游,使用注释对象参考点进行评估. 对于不同的对象,当它们的参考点最多以图像宽度的6%不同时,横向比较是未知的,垂直比较的相应阈值是图像高度的6%. 如前所说一切自性皆是虚妄. 因此,我们只保留一个项目,条件是其目标的所有上游人员都有已知的数值,而目标则是每个未知数值完成时唯一令人满意的候选人。 因此,目标必须满足描述,而所有其他候选人都必须失败,无论如何解决未知的比较。 我们要求至少有两个已知的上游值来区别目标与其他候选人. 单独地,我们将自我关系固定在虚假上,并将不同对象之间的所有关系视为未知,只有在至少两位候选人仍然能够满足描述时,才保留一个问题. 最后,在每个图像中,我们重复了布林等值于同一命名的上游的描述.

blocks.en: 4.4 Validation and dataset coverage
blocks.zh: 4.4 验证和数据集覆盖面

blocks.en: Yes/No validation uses an independent parser and a NumPy evaluator to replay rewrites and recompute logical and structural annotations. The validation suite reports 681,691 checks and evaluates 6,144,000 truth-table rows, covering all 1,024 assignments for each of the 6,000 expressions. A separate natural-language parser reconstructs all 6,000 Yes/No ASTs and verifies their reference answers. Automated geometric and sampled-pixel checks cover every generated image. Identification validation performs all 7,524 candidate evaluations and confirms that each recorded target is uniquely selected under the specified unknown-value semantics. These procedures verify logical consistency conditional on the recorded visual facts. Finally, we augment the quality assurance of these facts through a comprehensive human annotation review.
blocks.zh: 是/否 验证使用独立的解析器和NumPy评估器来重放重写和重计算逻辑和结构说明. 鉴定组报告681 691项核对和评估了6 144 000项真相表列,涵盖6 000项表述中每一项1 024项任务。 一个单独的自然语言解析器重建了所有6,000个是/否AST,并验证其参考答案. 自动几何和取样像素检查覆盖了每一个生成的图像. 鉴定验证进行所有7,524个候选评价,并确认每个记录的目标都是在指定的未知值语义下独选的. 这些程序以所记录的视觉事实为条件核查逻辑一致性。 最后,我们通过全面的人类注释审查,加强了对这些事实的质量保证。

blocks.en: The 3,000 base expressions represent 2,746 distinct truth tables. Displayed expressions contain 54–370 AST nodes and have edge depth 6–15. Each generated image supports four Yes/No questions. The photograph tracks share 46 images from 45 scene families, and the identification questions use 241 distinct photograph–target combinations. So, the questions share visual evidence, while some also share a target or Boolean function. The median symbolic Yes/No prompt contains 371 whitespace-delimited words, compared with 1,911.5 for its natural-language counterpart. Format comparisons also compare prompts of different lengths, and we group records by the expression’s root connective and predict each group’s majority answer, using the same records to determine and evaluate that prediction. This achieves 52.5% accuracy, indicating residual association between surface form and the answer. Appendices B and D provide further coverage statistics and validation commands.

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate eight VLMs in nine configurations (Table 4 ). Seven configurations use disabled-thinking settings or non-thinking Instruct variants, and Gemini uses its minimal-thinking setting. We refer to these eight configurations as the Thinking disabled or minimized , without asserting an absence of all internal reasoning. We also evaluate GLM-4.6V-FlashX with native thinking enabled. Each configuration is evaluated on both tasks in both presentation formats, yielding 126K final responses across the nine configurations. Appendix A records the requested API model identifiers and inference settings.
blocks.zh: 我们按9个配置评价8个甚高频(表4)。 7个配置使用了禁用思维设置或非思维指令变体,双子座则使用了其最小思维设置. 我们把这八种布局称为“思绪被禁”或“最小化”,而没有断言不存在任何内部推理。 我们还对GLM-4.6V-FlashX进行了本土思维评估。 每个配置都以两种列报格式评价这两个任务,在9个配置中产生126K最终回复. 附 录 一个记录请求的API模型标识符和推断设置.

blocks.en: Each request contains an image and a prompt, without reference answers or access to search, solvers, or code execution, with default temperatures. Prepared images have a maximum edge length of 2,048 2{,}048 pixels, though providers may apply additional preprocessing. The output-token cap is 2,048 2{,}048 for the disabled/minimal group and 4,096 4{,}096 for thinking-enabled GLM. While some answer-format instructions differ across models, we ensure that within each configuration, the symbolic and natural-language conditions use the same inference settings and answer-format policy.

blocks.en: Scoring. We parse the complete final response as either Yes / No or a single candidate label. Invalid, missing, and incomplete responses count as incorrect, and we do not extract answers from explanations. Appendix A elaborates on our permitted case, whitespace, punctuation, and markdown. Requests that failed due to API errors are retried with the same settings, whereas completed incorrect or invalid responses are retained. Every item in our evaluation has a final response after retries.
blocks.zh: S. 我们把完整的最后答复分为是/否或单一候选标签。 无效、缺失和不完整的答复都算作不正确,我们不从解释中提取答案。 附 录 详细介绍了我们允许的病例 白空间 标点和减值 因API错误而失败的请求在相同的设置下重审,而完成的不正确或无效的回复保留. 我们评价的每个项目在重新讨论后都有最后的答复。

blocks.en: Metrics. In each format, accuracy is computed over all 6K Boolean questions or all 1K identification questions, including invalid responses. For each Boolean format, both-correct accuracy is the fraction of all 3K equivalent-expression pairs for which both answers are correct. The conflict rate is the fraction of pairs with two valid outputs whose answers disagree. We report descriptive results without independent-trial confidence intervals because questions share scenes and expressions.

blocks.en: Higher item accuracy can coexist with conflicting answers. With thinking enabled, GLM answers both members correctly in 1,354 / 3,000 1{,}354/3{,}000 symbolic pairs ( 45.13 % 45.13\% ), compared with 39.13 % 39.13\% with thinking disabled. Despite this increase, both-correct accuracy remains below the 50 % 50\% constant-label baseline. The conflict rate also increases, from 18.90 % 18.90\% to 36.47 % 36.47\% among pairs with two valid outputs. Conversely, low conflict can coexist with strong label bias: in natural-language Boolean evaluation, GLM with thinking disabled predicts Yes on 98.60 % 98.60\% of all questions, with a conflict rate of only 1.67 % 1.67\% and accuracy of 50.37 % 50.37\% .

The remaining invalid responses from DeepSeek and Gemini finish generation but fail the final-answer parser. Appendix A reports these outcomes without extracting answers from explanatory prose. The reported accuracy thus reflects both correctness and the ability to return the requested answer within the specified output budget.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Hob-VL combines executable Boolean annotations, equivalent-expression pairs, and matched symbolic and natural-language prompts to evaluate visually grounded composition. Across eight configurations with thinking disabled/minimized, Boolean accuracy is close to the 50 % 50\% constant-label baseline, while identification accuracy varies substantially across formats. The thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves higher accuracy in several conditions but still produces frequent conflicts across equivalent expressions. These findings motivate reporting accuracy together with pairwise correctness, conflict rates, label frequencies, and output validity.
blocks.zh: Hob-VL结合了可执行布尔语注解,等效的表达对,并匹配符号和自然语言的提示来评价视觉上的基础成分. 在8个具有思维障碍/最小化的配置中,布尔精度接近50%的50QQ恒定标签基线,而识别精度则在格式上差别很大. 思维驱动的GLM配置在几个条件下都实现了更高的准确度,但仍会产生对等表达式之间的频繁冲突. 这些调查结果激励了报告准确性,以及双向正确性、冲突率、标签频率和输出有效性。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Hob-VL is intended to support research on visually grounded Boolean composition. Its results should be interpreted within the scope of its two tasks and image collection. The 46 photographs were taken by the authors. We reviewed the images and prompts for identifying information and sensitive content.

blocks.en: Prompt policies. GPT-5.6 Luna uses the original dataset prompts in all four task–format conditions. Every other Boolean configuration appends: “Respond with exactly one word: Yes or No. Do not include explanations, Markdown, punctuation, or any other text.” For identification, Claude Haiku 4.5, DeepSeek, both GLM configurations, Llama, and Qwen append a label-only instruction; Grok and Gemini use the original prompts. The recorded policies are original , boolean-one-word-v1 , and answer-only-v1 . The original identification prompt already requests a single label, which the suffix reinforces. Prepared-image hashes verify that matched questions use the same image. Prompt hashes identify the format-specific prompts and verify that the same prompt is used in both GLM thinking configurations.

blocks.en: Parsers and retries. Case, surrounding whitespace, and one terminal period or exclamation mark are tolerated. Luna’s saved policy accepts a plain answer; all other configurations additionally accept one answer enclosed in Markdown bold. Uniformly reapplying the plain-or-bold parser to completed outputs changes none of the reported accuracies. Multiple labels, explanatory prose, empty final answers, and incomplete generations remain incorrect, even if they mention the reference answer. Only infrastructure errors are retried; the most recent settled response is scored once per ID. Earlier error rows remain in the append-only histories.
blocks.zh: 解与复试. 案件,周围的白空间,以及一个终端期或感叹标记被容忍. Luna的保存策略接受一个简单答案;所有其他配置都接受一个包含在Markdown粗体中的答案。 统一地重新应用普通或粗体分析器来完成产出,没有任何变化。 多个标签,解释性说法,空洞的最终答案,以及不完全的代代仍然不正确,即使它们提到了参考答案. 仅重审基础设施错误;最近确定的答复每ID一次。 先前的错误行仍然保留在仅附件的历史中 。

Diagnostic role. Flipping any one input changes the output. Consequently, each input has influence one and every assignment has certificate size ten over the unrestricted Boolean domain. These constructions specify controlled logical properties; whether they challenge a particular model is an empirical question.

blocks.en: B.6 Image selection and identification coverage

blocks.en: Starting from 55 source images, we excluded seven duplicate photographs, one game screenshot, and one image with an existing screen frame. The retained 46 photographs belong to 45 scene families. Each photograph supports 42 or 44 Yes/No questions and 21 or 22 identification questions. The 1,000 identification questions use nine templates in approximately equal proportions and cover 241 distinct photograph–target combinations. The target is also named as a reference object in 541 questions. Among the 7,524 candidate evaluations, 1,789 include an unknown comparison; there are 1,968 unknown candidate–predicate comparisons in total. Each question has the same unique target under every completion of these unknown values. Under the finite-candidate identification criterion, the minimum number of predicate values needed to identify the target is two for 870 questions and three for 130 questions.

blocks.en:
For Yes/No questions, the symbolic prompt lists the visual statements and then
gives a fully parenthesized Boolean expression. The structured natural-language
(NL) compiler traverses the same abstract syntax tree (AST), replacing each
variable occurrence with its corresponding statement. It renders AND as
“Both of the following conditions hold,” OR as “At least one of the following
conditions holds, possibly both,” and NOT as “It is not the case that the
following condition holds.” Indentation identifies each operator’s immediate
subconditions. Thus, OR remains inclusive, NOT applies to its entire child, and
repeated variables retain the same visual referents.

blocks.en:
Evaluation histories retain raw responses, parsing outcomes, finish reasons,
token usage, and retry records. Before generating a result table, the reporting
code checks that every planned request has a final response after retries, verifies the
reference answers and evidence shared by paired prompts, and compares saved
summary counts with counts recomputed from the histories. Models receive only
the prompt and prepared image; reference answers and annotation records are used
locally for validation and scoring. Reconstructing the dataset requires the source images, Python 3.11 or later,
Pillow, NumPy, and the font configured by the renderer. Model aliases and provider
defaults can change, limiting exact reproduction of API outputs.
